name: base-office-forms
description: BASE forms and documents kit hosted on Cloudflare Pages

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const file of ['public/index.html','public/home.js','public/builder.html','public/studio.js','public/engine.js','public/library-api.js','public/form-generator.html','public/viewer.html','public/assets/base-logo.svg','functions/api/[[path]].ts','migrations/0001_shared_library.sql','migrations/0002_schema_marker.sql']) { if (!fs.existsSync(file)) throw new Error('Missing '+file); } console.log('BASE Pages build ready');"
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run functions:build
